# Engine DEVELOPER.md lists reduced motion among the paths that omit deferResourceApplication

Discovered from: MS-0MW20KSEG001DH1X (Turn summary dialog suppressed by reduced motion setting).

## Problem

`core/docs/DEVELOPER.md` (the Tableau-Card-Engine submodule), section *Deferred End-of-Turn Mutation* → bullet *Deferred `processEndOfTurn`*, says:

> Tutorial, reduced-motion and replay paths omit the flag (legacy immediate behaviour, no regression — AC5).

After MS-0MW20KSEG001DH1X the reduced-motion path does **not** omit the flag: the scene (`src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerTurnFlow.ts`, `endTurn`) takes the deferred closing path under reduced motion, so the Turn Summary dialog has a `requiresDeferredClosing` result to gate on. Only the tutorial and replay paths still omit it.

## Why it was not fixed in the MS session

- `core` is a git submodule (a separate repository, detached HEAD at the engine pin `5a16c2f`). A working-tree edit leaves the submodule dirty, and `npm run build` runs `engine:sync` (non-soft), which **refuses** to sync a dirty submodule ("never clobber") — every later build in this repo would fail.
- A local commit inside the submodule is discarded by the next `engine:sync` (it checks out the remote target), so the fix would silently vanish.
- The engine checkout has no worklog (`wl` there reports "not initialized"), and pushing to the engine repo's `dev` is not authorised from a game-repo session.

## Fix

In the Tableau-Card-Engine repository, amend that bullet so only the tutorial and replay paths are named as flag-omitting, and state that the reduced-motion path takes the deferred closing so a game's Turn Summary gate can present its summary dialog (cross-reference the game-side behaviour).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `core/docs/DEVELOPER.md` no longer claims the reduced-motion path omits `deferResourceApplication`.
2. The bullet names the tutorial and replay paths as the immediate/flag-omitting ones and explains why the reduced-motion path is deferred.
3. No code change is required; the engine's documentation guards (if any) still pass.
data.title: Engine DEVELOPER.md lists reduced motion among the paths that omit deferResourceApplication

## Goal

Implement the card-level redesign deltas stated in the GDD staff system (`docs/game/the-build-gdd.md`, Appendix D.4) so the shipped cards match the two-type model.

discovered-from:MS-0MW2XMA0Z007MZ6D (GDD draft), parent epic MS-0MW20VBSZ003A01O.

## Scope (from the GDD "Redesign delta" columns)

Value changes:
- `staff-assistant`: `handSlotsAdded` 1 → 2.
- `staff-executive`: `handSlotsAdded` 1 → 0, `actionsPerTurn` 1 → 2.
- `staff-baker`: adjacency Food bonus → +25 coins/turn to its own business.
- `staff-event-planner`: clarified as an adjacency effect (+100/turn from adjacent Entertainment businesses).

Scope tightenings (street-wide → business cluster):
- `staff-chef` (nearby Food businesses → +20% coin income to its own business only), `staff-security` (own business + adjacent), `staff-maintenance` (own + adjacent), `staff-health-safety` (own business only), `staff-marketing` (own business only), `staff-pr` (own business only), `staff-delivery` (adjacent-business purchases only), `staff-it` (street-wide refresh discount → +1 synergy range for its own business).

Enforcement:
- Type = assignment: business staff carry `employedAtSlot`, management-company staff never do; hiring a management-company member never requests a destination, and `placeStaffOnBusiness` rejects it.
- Business-staff reputation/cost effects must be per-business buffs, not the street-wide `reputationPerTurn` field.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `src/card-data.csv` and the parsed templates reflect every value change and scope tightening above.
2. Engine buff wiring applies business-staff effects only to the employing business (plus its 8-way neighbours where the role says so), and management-company effects only to the player.
3. Two-type assignment/validation rules in GDD D.4.2/D.4.8 are enforced and covered by tests.
4. Full test suite passes.

## Constraints

- Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md` (release pipeline owns it).
- Balance magnitudes are provisional; keep the existing seeded-RNG determinism.

**Key Files:**
- src/card-data.csv
- src/MainStreetCardsTemplates.ts
- src/MainStreetCardsTypes.ts
- src/MainStreetStaffBuffs.ts
- src/MainStreetStaffSkills.ts
- src/MainStreetEngineCommands.ts
- src/MainStreetAdjacencyScoring.ts
- docs/game/the-build-gdd.md (reference)

## Plan: changelog

- 2026-11-06 — Plan skill review (auto-complete path; effort Extra Small / risk Low, no decomposition needed): added the missing `staff-chef` scope tightening from GDD D.4.3/D.4.7; completed the **Key Files** list with the parsed-template and engine files the ACs already require (`MainStreetCardsTemplates.ts`, `MainStreetEngineCommands.ts`, `MainStreetAdjacencyScoring.ts`). No other intent changes.
data.title: Implement two-type staff redesign deltas in card data and engine

# Loan payoff dialog: carry the payoff across a paused closing

discovered-from:MS-0MW3SN58E009HC84

## Goal (user story)

As a player whose loan retires in a turn that also pauses on an event-choice
dialog (or a bankruptcy bailout offer), I want to still see the debt-free
congratulation once the pause resolves, so that no payoff goes unnotified.

## Context

`MS-0MW3SN58E009HC84` presents the payoff dialog in the closing presentation
slot (`MainStreetLoanPayoffModel.presentLoanPayoffDialogs`), after the closing
animations and ahead of the End of Turn summary. Two pauses resolve **after**
that slot, so their payoffs are currently never presented:

- **Event choice**: `processEndOfTurn` retires the loan and then pauses
  (`choicePending`) before `finishTurnPresentation` reaches the presentation
  slot. The resume path (`onEventChoice` → `finishDeferredEndOfTurn`) builds a
  fresh result that does **not** carry `loanPayoffs`.
- **Bankruptcy bailout**: the deferred result pauses on the loan offer
  (`pendingLoanOffer`); `onLoanOfferChoice` resumes through
  `completeDeferredClosingTail`, which never presents payoffs. A declined offer
  ends the run, so game over correctly wins there; an **accepted** offer
  continues the run with no congratulation.

The paused path never duplicates a dialog (there is only one presentation slot),
so this is a *missed* notification, not a duplicate.

## Desired change

Carry the paused closing's `loanPayoffs` into the resumed flow (the same
pattern `pendingBankingHint` uses for the banking hint) and present them via
the existing `presentLoanPayoffDialogs` sequencer on the continuing resume
path — never on a resume that ends the run (game over wins).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. An event-choice-paused closing that retired a loan presents exactly one
   congratulation when the choice resolves, and never two.
2. A bailout-paused closing where the seat accepts an offer (the run continues)
   presents exactly one congratulation; a declined offer (the run ends)
   presents the game-over overlay and no congratulation.
3. The dialog still appears only after the closing presentation and never
   alongside another modal.
4. Unit tests cover both pause paths, including the no-duplicate rule.

## Key Files

- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerTurnFlow.ts` — carry the payoffs across
  `presentEventChoiceDialog` / `presentLoanOfferDialog` and present them on the
  continuing resume.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetLoanPayoffModel.ts` — `presentLoanPayoffDialogs`
  (reused unchanged).
- `tests/main-street/loan-payoff-turn-flow.test.ts` — the pause/resume cases.

## Constraints

- Presentation only: no engine, arithmetic, wallet or RNG change.
- One modal at a time; the summary/bailout/event-choice pacing is unchanged.
data.title: Loan payoff dialog: carry the payoff across a paused closing

# Implement P&L projection model (MS-0MW4XULA90002OEY)

## Summary

Add a pure TypeScript profit/loss projection function to MainStreetTurnSummary.ts that transforms a selected player's TurnResult ledger into ordered P&L lines with supplementary context.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A `buildPLProjection(state, result, playerKey)` function exists in `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnSummary.ts` (or a small helper module).
- The function returns a projection with: an Income section (base / synergy / reputation / events lines with total), a Less: Operating expenses section (staff / community / business lines with total), Incident and One-off adjustments, and an emphasised Net profit/loss bottom line.
- Supplementary context (reputation change, score change, closing coin balance, businesses owned) is returned alongside the P&L lines but is not mixed into them.
- The returned lines reconcile: incomeTotal + expensesTotal + incident.coins + oneOff.coins == net.coins.
- A tab model is provided: one tab per player with id, label, colour, isHuman flag, and default tab set to the human player.
- No Phaser/game-engine dependencies — pure TypeScript, importable in tests.
- Unit tests pass (see child MS-0MW5EPEXW000AZKO).

## Dependencies

- MS-0MW5EPEXW000AZKO (Write P&L model unit tests)

## Deliverables

- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnSummary.ts` — new `buildPLProjection` function and tab model
- Existing unit tests pass

## Key Files

- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnSummary.ts` — add projection function
- `src/MainStreetEngineTypes.ts` — reference TurnLedger / OwnerRoundLedger shapes
- `tests/main-street/turn-summary-pl-model.test.ts` — consume projection (test child)
data.title: Implement P&L projection model

# Implement tabbed P&L overlay (MS-0MW4XULA90002OEY)

## Summary

Replace the existing single-player `showTurnSummaryDialog` and competitive `showCompetitiveTurnSummaryDialog` with a single unified tabbed P&L overlay that presents each player's management company as a profit/loss statement.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A unified `showTurnSummaryDialog` function replaces both the single-player and competitive layouts. It renders a tab strip (one tab per player, human/"You" default) plus the P&L statement body for the selected tab.
- Single-player mode shows a single non-interactive "You" tab. Competitive mode shows one interactive tab per non-eliminated player.
- Selecting a player's tab switches the entire statement body to that player's P&L figures.
- The P&L layout matches the model output: Income section (base/synergy/reputation/events with total), Less: Operating expenses (staff/community/business with total), Incident and One-off adjustments, emphasised Net profit/loss.
- Non-monetary figures (reputation/score change, closing balances, businesses owned) appear as supplementary context outside the P&L lines.
- The existing [ Next Turn ] / [ Bank Loan ] behaviour is preserved, including in-place re-render after a loan take while preserving the selected tab.
- The loan descriptor (`buildTurnSummaryLoanDescriptor` / competitive equivalent) and bank loan action seam keep working.
- The overlay uses existing conventions: `createOverlayBackground` + `createOverlayButton`, `hudContainer` parenting, depths 199/200/201, `s.overlayObjects` for dismissal, instant appearance (reduced-motion safe), `safePlaySound` for button SFX.
- Tabs are operable by pointer and keyboard.
- All browser tests pass (see child MS-0MW5EQHFK005NXXM).

- Each player has its own tab; the human ("You") tab is selected by default when the dialog opens, and selecting another player's tab switches the whole statement to that player's figures.
- One unified tabbed P&L replaces both the single-player `showTurnSummaryDialog` and competitive `showCompetitiveTurnSummaryDialog` layouts. Single-player shows a single non-interactive "You" tab. Every value shown today is preserved — either as a P&L line or in the supplementary context — and no `TurnResult` ledger field changes.

## Dependencies

- MS-0MW5EQ0BA004E4QY (Implement P&L projection model) — provides the projection function
- MS-0MW5EQHFK005NXXM (Write overlay browser tests) — must pass

## Deliverables

- `src/scenes/MainStreetOverlayContent.ts` — unified `showTurnSummaryDialog` and `showCompetitiveTurnSummaryDialog`
- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnSummary.ts` — tab model consumed by overlay
- Existing browser tests pass

## Key Files

- `src/scenes/MainStreetOverlayContent.ts` — new unified tabbed overlay layout
- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnSummary.ts` — P&L projection and tab model
- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerTurnFlow.ts` — gate may be unchanged
- `tests/main-street/turn-summary-pl-overlay.browser.test.ts` — consume overlay (test child)

## Risks

- The competitive panel carries more per-seat figures than the single-player dialog. The unified layout must keep all of them.
- Re-presenting after a loan take must rebuild the statement for the currently selected player and not reset unexpectedly.
data.title: Implement tabbed P&L overlay
